approximation_notes: Cadence approximation: the live orchestrator refits both HMMs from scratch on every 15-minute tick (rolling 200x1h bars); this repro treats one hourly bar as one tick and refits every 24 bars, re-predicting the label every bar from the most recent fit on the current trailing window (repo predict() semantics: fit-time standardization).  No EM warm-start / cross-tick label-continuity matching: each refit uses hmmlearn auto-init plus the rank-sort label map (regime_engine.py:1155-1156) — the repo's first-fit behavior and the exact behavior the 20261019 evaluation criticizes.

kairos book: EV gate priced on the shipped ATR bracket in R units (the live gate prices the brick payoff x ATR probability — W-C1); p_win is the full-sample measured-table approximation (repo behavior).
MC first passage: sub-stepped near-continuous monitoring (sub=16/bar; repo test convention tests/test_barrier_null.py:111-140); same-sub-step double touches count as neither (repo convention).

mu_hat interpretation: direction-aligned TREND-regime drift (mean of (c[i+24]-c[i])/atr[i] x sign(er_signed) over TREND-labeled train slots, shrunk n/(n+100)) — the drift the sign(er_signed) book harvests; equals the literal signed mean when all TREND slots agree.
Entry basis: stale close[i] kept faithfully (repo policy, W-G1) for the head-to-head proof.

MC monitoring convention: the spec's 'hourly steps' MC carries a +0.05 overshoot bias vs the continuous-monitoring analytic (measured); all reported probabilities therefore use sub-stepped monitoring at 64 sub-steps/bar (bias ~+0.005, within the 0.01 large-T validation tolerance), and the corrected-geometry solver grid runs at 16 sub-steps/bar with a 0.01 margin on the pi_SL cap so reported numbers stay under the published 0.62 cap.

Corrected-geometry constraints are enforced UNDER THE DRIFTLESS NULL (pi_SL at the longest expiry, pi_E at the chosen expiry) so the corrected bracket is never an SL-farm by physics even if the drift estimate is wrong; EV is maximised under the drifted MC.

verdicts.title: The EV gate prices a bracket that is never shipped (brick payoff x ATR probability)
verdicts.evidence: Repro of the live gate at the shipped band centres: the 'EV > 0' gate passed 24% of conf-passing slots — the pass rate is driven by the shipped RR and the flat base table, not by regime state, so the gate cannot discriminate brackets; the LIVE gate is weaker still (it prices the fictional brick payoff, ev_engine.py:723-728 vs orchestrator.py:4202-4219).

verdicts.title: Heavy sweep fails open on unscored brackets (directional-EV leak)
verdicts.evidence: Code-path audit at HEAD (heavy_sweep.py:1579-1604, 2386-2402): unscored bucket -> directional p_win (~0.55+) vs global 0.20 floor passes trivially.  Engine side: the same pass-always gate behavior is reproduced above (W-C1 numbers).

verdicts.title: Calibration loop scores a mixed-semantics, survivor-biased target (expired excluded)
verdicts.evidence: The repo's flat bucket table carries level but no discrimination (mean AUC 0.5772 measured here on all-in outcomes including expiry — reproducing the repo's own measured 0.4869); the regime-conditional model's lockbox discrimination is weak on this sample (mean AUC 0.5328). The live loop's expired-excluded population is a code-audit finding (eod_resolver.py:943-944).

verdicts.title: Cost-blind, expiry-zero EV with single-gate dependency
verdicts.evidence: Under the driftless null every current band-centre has EV <= -cost (measured with the repo's own barrier_null + independent MC); live EV charges expiry at 0 with no costs.

verdicts.title: Nine p_win variants with crossing semantics
verdicts.evidence: Code-audit census at HEAD (evaluation Part 1): 9 p_win variants; consumers re-blending get numbers unrelated to the shipped p_win.  Not re-measurable without live DB.

verdicts.title: Scale-crossing enforcement + path asymmetries
verdicts.evidence: Code-audit at HEAD: Bayesian shrink thresholds derived for the directional scale are fed the bracket base rate; Kelly reads the raw label while direction reads the debounced one.

verdicts.title: No neutral/abstention state in the live 4-state trend vocabulary
verdicts.evidence: Rank-based state->label guarantees a directional label on every fitted bar (decided fraction 100% here); the tri-state er label abstains on a measured fraction of bars.

verdicts.title: Direction source has measured negative skill yet is the sole direction decision
verdicts.evidence: 24h-ahead accuracy vs majority baseline per symbol on the repro HMM; regime values (er_signed) carry the measured edge information instead (best Spearman rho reported).

verdicts.title: Debounce converts whipsaw into stale-direction lock-in + 3h adoption lag
verdicts.evidence: Raw labels flip at measured rates in low-ER (chop) windows while the debouncer freezes direction (repo mechanism, reproduced verbatim); DM kairos-vs-corrected pooled p=0.0163, mld=-0.0336: kairos better on the same slot grid (the corrected book abstains rather than trading stale direction).

verdicts.title: Zero live chop gates (every consolidation detector is shadow/stamp-only)
verdicts.evidence: Census at HEAD (evaluation Part 2.4): efficiency_24h, trend_filter consolidating, dynamic_min_rr, context alignment, router stand_by all shadow.  Engine measures the edge surface conditional on chop/ER (decile monotonicity in summary).

verdicts.title: regime_conf >= 0.60 does not brake chop
verdicts.evidence: Mean HMM confidence inside bottom-quartile-ER (most choppy) windows vs the 0.60 gate.

verdicts.title: HMM neutrality doesn't reach published EV; ~30h directional memory vs sub-30h chop
verdicts.evidence: Bracket substitution decouples published EV from regime state: the kairos book's EV-gate pass rate measured 21% in TREND slots vs 26% in NEUTRAL slots (HMM neutrality never reaches EV — code audit); trend features are 30-bar cum returns (regime_engine.py:894-903) vs sub-30h chop cycles.

verdicts.title: Entry is a stale close under a clock-slot policy, uncompensated
verdicts.evidence: Repo's own SSE entry-timing measurement: -30pt selection gap vs null at 89.5% SL in tight buckets, direction AUC 0.499.  Engine keeps the stale-close basis faithfully.

verdicts.title: Tight-SL bands are SL-farms by physics (risk moved, not removed)
verdicts.evidence: pi_SL at current band centres under the driftless null (repo barrier_null + independent MC agree) vs the physics-constrained corrected geometry.

verdicts.title: 48h fixed deadline vs wide bands: expiry-farm + starvation
verdicts.evidence: US500 band pi_E=0.70 under the null (repo + MC cross-check); corrected geometry is constrained to pi_E <= 0.25 by construction.

verdicts.title: Nothing physics- or reachability-based constrains the published bracket
verdicts.evidence: Current band centres violate the physics constraints outright (XAUUSD pi_SL 0.83 > 0.62; every current EV_null <= -cost); the corrected solver enforces (pi_SL, pi_E, RR) constraints UNDER THE NULL with measured drift on top.

verdicts.title: Evidence-free geometry paths (n=0 band-centre picks, absolute-unit cold start)
verdicts.evidence: Code audit: band-centre/best-effort picks ship n=0/exp=0 metadata; cold-start brick fallback (0.5, 3, 6) in absolute price units; pooled-evidence widening is dead code.

No EM warm-start / cross-tick label-continuity matching: each refit uses hmmlearn auto-init plus the rank-sort label map (regime_engine.py:1155-1156) — the repo's first-fit behavior and the exact behavior the 20261019 evaluation criticizes.

pooled.note: trades concatenated symbol-blocked; DM on per-slot series (abstain/skip slots contribute R=0)

tsfm_reframe.conclusion: Zero-shot TSFMs carry no directional edge: no chronos arm significantly beats HAR on QLIKE in any of the 20 cells (0 Holm-significant wins), while HAR/HAR-EWMA beat naive in 16/20 and 18/20 cells. TSFM's role is calibrated vol spreads for sizing/geometry (Phase 0.5 recalibration accepted 46/100 cells at mean b=0.7166, k=2.2506); DIRECTION/EDGE comes from regime values (this engine).
